tools.name: get_real_estate_stats
tools.description:
Aggregate real estate market statistics (count, average & median price USD, average & median price per sqm USD, min/max price, average area) grouped by district, renovation_status, construction_stage, rooms, seller_type, or complex.
<hints>
- Ideal for market analytics: comparing prices across city

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description: Get complete specifications, full description, seller contact info (phone, contacts, source_url), photo URLs, rooftop coordinates, and complex affiliation for one or up to 15 properties in a single call.

tools.name: search_complexes
tools.description: Search residential developments and new building projects with developer details, delivery status, coordinates, distance to sea, and gas availability.

tools.name: get_complex_details
tools.description: Get detailed profile of one or up to 15 residential complexes including developer name, delivery year, address, rooftop coordinates, and counts & sample active properties currently for sale and rent.

tools.name: get_item_details
tools.description: Get details for one or up to 15 secondhand classified items including full description, photo gallery, seller username, and original Telegram message link.

tools.name: execute_code_mode
tools.description:
Execute a JavaScript snippet inside an isolated QuickJS WASM sandbox with direct synchronous/async access to the Hotyata SDK (`sdk`).
Use this "MCP Code Mode" tool whenever you need to run multi-step queries, compare multiple categories/districts/stages, join complexes with properties, filter or agg

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Report an issue with data accuracy, stale or off-market listings, incorrect coordinates, spam, or tool usability limitations. AI agents should call this when finding inaccuracies or when human users report off-market listings.
